sloka: अनुजग्मुः च भर्तारम् क्रोशंत्यः करुण स्वनाः ।तासाम् रुदित शब्देन वानरीणाम् वन अंतरे ॥४-२५-३६॥
transliteration: anujagmuḥ ca bhartāram krośaṁtyaḥ karuṇa svanāḥ ।tāsām rudita śabdena vānarīṇām vana aṁtare ॥4-25-36॥

translations.english: Tormented with tears, the monkeys prepared in a solitary place surrounded by waters a pyre on the sandbank of a mountain stream.
